newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firms in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firms in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in after-hours trade on Thursday, lifted by active short-covering from trade houses, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.4 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark May contract was unchanged at 147.4 yen.
During the day, three distant months hit their life-of-contract highs. Daily volume was 7,630 lots.
"The spot contract held firm tone throughout the day. Expectations that deliveries at Friday's spot expiry will be small, encouraged market sentiment," one trader said.
